fr.name: Pike push-up
fr.description: Pompe hanches hautes, en V inversé, qui oriente l’effort vers les épaules.
instructions: Mets-toi en position de pompe, puis recule les pieds et monte les hanches pour former un V inversé.
Garde les bras et les jambes aussi tendus que possible, la tête entre les bras.
Plie les coudes pour descendre le haut de la tête vers le sol, devant tes mains.
Pousse pour revenir bras tendus, hanches toujours hautes.
commonMistakes: Laisser les hanches descendre, ce qui transforme l’exercice en pompe classique.
Poser la tête au sol ou descendre trop vite.
Écarter fortement les coudes sur les côtés.
fr.mediaAlt: Pike push-up : personne en V inversé, hanches hautes, mains et pieds au sol.

en.name: Pike push-up
en.description: A push-up with the hips high in an inverted V, which shifts the work to the shoulders.
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an inverted V.
Keep your arms and legs as straight as you can, head between your arms.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor, just in front of your hands.
Press back up to straight arms, hips still high.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips drop, which turns it into a regular push-up.
Resting the head on the floor or lowering too fast.
Flaring the elbows wide to the sides.
en.mediaAlt: Pike push-up: a person in an inverted V, hips high, hands and feet on the floor.
